    non_bg_colors = [c for c in colors if c != background and c != 8]

    # Check for horizontal separator (full row)
    horizontal_sep = None
    for row in grid:
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            c = row[0]
            if c != background:
                horizontal_sep = c
                break

    vertical_sep = None
    if horizontal_sep is None:
        for c_idx, col in enumerate(zip(*grid)):
            if len(set(col)) == 1:
                c = col[0]
                if c != background:
                    vertical_sep = c
                    break
    
    # Determine object color
